commit.message:
[Sprint] v3.0.0 — Astro 6 migration + Wender Media Source License v1.0

Major release migrating from Astro 5 to Astro 6 with full ecosystem update.

License:
- MIT → Wender Media Source License v1.0 (source-available proprietary
  with attribution requirements + weak copyleft).
- v2.1.0 remains MIT on npm for legacy Astro 4/5 consumers.

Astro 6.3.1:
- Drop Astro 4/5 peer support; require Node 22.12+
- All @astrojs/* integrations bumped to Astro-6-compatible versions
  (mdx 5, react 5, solid-js 6, svelte 8, vue 6, partytown 2.1.7,
  sitemap 3.7.2, starlight 0.39.1)
- Vite 7+8 supported via overrides

Tailwind 4:
- @astrojs/tailwind removed (EOL — no Astro 6 support).
- Replaced with @tailwindcss/vite + tailwindcss@4 in optionalDependencies.

Templates (28 files migrated):
- 7 ViewTransitions → ClientRouter (layouts + view-transitions)
- 4 content-collections → Content Layer API (loader: glob() + file())
- 5 astro.configs → Tailwind 4 Vite plugin pattern
- z.string().email/url/uuid → z.email/url/uuid (zod 4 syntax)
- entry.slug → entry.id in api-endpoints/search.ts
- output: 'hybrid' → 'server' (Astro 5+ removed 'hybrid')
- X-XSS-Protection removed from deployment templates (anti-feature)

Bundles (8 bundles migrated):
- All astro.configs Tailwind 4 swap
- 4 content configs moved to src/content.config.ts + Content Layer API
- bundles/blog rss.xml.ts: post.slug → post.id
- React 18 → 19, all integration majors bumped
- Starlight bumped to 0.39.1 (Astro 6 support added in 0.38)

Storybook 8 → 10:
- addon-essentials, addon-interactions, addon-links, blocks dropped
  (absorbed into core in v9, removed in v10)
- @storybook/addon-docs added for MDX/Meta parsing
- .storybook/main.ts, preview.ts, manager.ts migrated to subpath imports
- Welcome.mdx: @storybook/blocks → @storybook/addon-docs/blocks
- 158 stories preserved as-is (canonical Meta/StoryObj pattern still valid)

Source code (176 files):
- All copyright headers updated: MIT → WMSL v1.0
- index.ts version bumped to 3.0.0
- ESLint config: storybook-static added to ignores

New documentation:
- LICENSE: full Wender Media Source License v1.0 (354 lines, 14 sections)
- NOTICE: SPDX, authorship, trademark, third-party pointer
- docs/MIGRATION-2.x-to-3.0.md: comprehensive consumer migration guide
- CONTRIBUTOR-REPORT.md (renamed from OPEN-SOURCE-REPORT.md)
- CHANGELOG.md: detailed 3.0.0 entry

Astro integrations catalogue:
- Added 'astro-component' keyword for auto-discovery on
  astro.build/integrations (per Sarah11918-astro feedback).

Verifications:
- ✅ npm install clean (847 packages, 0 vulnerabilities)
- ✅ Tests: 10/10 passing
- ✅ ESLint: 96 issues (9 errors, 87 warnings — all pre-existing in
  src/ui/Toast.astro + Tooltip.astro, not migration-caused)
- ✅ Storybook 10 build: success (498 files, 960kB iframe.js)
- ✅ npm pack: v3.0.0, 1.5MB tarball, 4.1MB unpacked
- ✅ SPDX consistency: LicenseRef-Wender-Media-Source-1.0 across all
  meta + 176 source code headers

Migration ratified by Arnold Wender 2026-05-08, executed via 4 parallel
wm-senior-engineer sub-agents (Sprints A/B/C/D) with file-scope-disjoint
guarantee, then Conductor verification gates and gap fixes.
